newsitem.title: CHINA: YUAN HOLDS FIRM ABOVE 8.2900 VS U.S. DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: YUAN HOLDS FIRM ABOVE 8.2900 VS U.S. DOLLAR.

text.p: The Chinese yuan held firm 8.2895 on Monday, little changed from a 26-month high of 8.2894 to the dollar set on Friday on expectations of good trade data expected to be released later this week, dealers said.
However, trading was not active because buyers had little intention of pushing the currency higher, they said.
"Most people believe the trade surplus will keep on increasing so demand for the yuan will continue to grow," one dealer said.
"Before the trade data are released, investors prefer to keep it to the current level," another dealer said.
Dealers said investors wanted to see the currency consolidate with the 8.2900 level as a bottom and expected the yuan to move higher than that on Tuesday.
The yuan opened almost unchanged at 8.2896 and consolidated in a narrow range between an intraday high of 8.2892 and 8.2897 for most of the session, hitting a brief low of 8.2946.
The weighted average price on Friday was 8.2897.
The yuan closed down at 7.1690 from 6.9851 against 100 Japanese yen and slightly up at 1.0698 from 1.0700 against the Hong Kong dollar.
